kind: fixed teaching inputs, not measured engine data
protocol: No EOS or output cap. K drafts yield the accepted prefix and one residual token at first rejection, or one bonus token if all K pass. K=0 directly draws one target token without drafting.

selectionBias.badPolicy: Inspect continuation confidence after sampling x1, then maximize the full K=0,1,2 score curve retrospectively; still verify using the original q.
selectionBias.safePolicy: Stop at the first score that does not improve, before consulting any continuation-dependent confidence. This example always chooses K=0.
